text.tspan: CLI entrypoint — detect / sync / enrich / export / course / vj

g.text: connections/ — transport layer, no app-specific deps
cli.py — dj enrich [--detect|--sync] + dj enrich analyse
engine.py — shared enrich engine → Beatport metadata
studio_sdk.py / dj_studio_sdk.js — SDK driver + Node helper
beatport.py — HTTP client + session token capture
db.py — all detect + enrich DB ops
capture.py — dj sync music|spotify → sync_tracks + sync_playlist_tracks
push.py — dj sync <app> playlist push → recreate an app playlist
db.py / cli.py — canonical store + membership; dispatch
query.py — user SQL → beatport_ids + full row fetch
cli.py — export set / beatport / rekordbox verbs
course/ — offline course viewer (dj course start/stop)
extension/ — dj extension pack <name> (zip any extension)
cats/ — p5.js + Meyda + aubio.js cat visualizer
